poc_plan_summary: 4-week Dedicated POC: week1 infra + model onboarding; week2 canary (10% traffic) with monitoring; week3 ramp to 50% if stable; week4 full cutover test and rollback runbook. Canary policy: route 10% of sessions to Dedicated pool, remainder to Hosted for comparison. Fallbacks: primary -> smaller quantized variant (same region) -> different region (EU <-> US) -> Hosted API. Rollback triggers: p99 latency > 2x target, error rate increase > 0.8%, token cost exceed 40% over forecast, KV cache eviction rate anomalies. SLO targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms at expected load (200 qps burst capacity for 30s).

technical_requirements:
- Models: prefers open LlamaX-3-22B quantized and a smaller 7B variant for fallback.

- Encryption: KMS keys customer-managed, audit logs retained 2 years for EU customers.
- Network: VPC peering + static egress IPs for allowlisting.
